purpose: Close the finite default-newTask selectChat question and adopt a Codex-only reconstruction boundary using existing analysis.

retain: Shared draft preparation and selected/project/group context responsibilities of wH/Ati/U7r.
Command eligibility, navigation preparation failure, onNavigate/setup ordering and actual action on handled keyboard commands.
Separate draft preparation from FSC-0048 creation/first-turn submission.
omitOrAdapt: Omit the already-qualified switchToMode1 Chat registration.
Adapt the newTask keyboard variant so it cannot switch to Chat.
Separate final h7r Chat-kind reveal from shared draft preparation; route the retained Codex operation through an explicit Codex draft reveal adapter.
Do not preserve explicit Chat system-hint/mode targets in the Codex-only interface; retain applicable shared draft state.
featurePolicy.proposalQualification: The Codex draft reveal adapter is a proposed restoration boundary. Simply changing selectChat to false is not proven equivalent: h7r calls a reveal provider whose effects were not expanded or executed.
acceptanceObligations: Ordinary and shortcut newTask perform a Codex draft action without entering Chat; command eligibility still applies.
Selected, local/remote group and allowed projectless context preserve their distinct selection semantics.
Navigation preparation rejection prevents subsequent onNavigate/setup on the source branch; gm behavior is separately specified.
Fresh/reused draft and focus behavior match the intended Codex operation; preview option precedence is explicit.
Opening a draft does not submit a model task; actual submission remains a separate operation.
Provider reveal side effects and runtime winning handler require later verification; source readback is not a product pass.

facts.claim: wH prepares navigation unless gm() is true. With !gm and null prepareNavigation it returns before onNavigate and subsequent setup. With gm true it can run onNavigate/mode/setup but returns before refetch, ordinary draft preparation and final navigation. The effective gm value is delegated; no mode was inferred from the flag name.

Ati keeps explicit target then U7r selected/group/projectless decision. U7r distinguishes remote host and eligible local projects before projectless/default selection. These existing context operations remain retained; a single replacement Chat/Codex label does not preserve them.
